results.name: media/scrubber hover with a preview card, 1 kHz mouse, real loop
results.description: The scrubber hover row with a still for every minute of the film, as Reel makes them (120 pictures, each its own image): the card above the bar follows the pointer, crossing two or three stills a frame, so its place, picture and time change every frame drawn; Application.Run's own loop on the virtual clock for 10 frames, then one more (all under build); reports the player's builds per frame drawn

results.name: loop/idle window, 5 s, real loop
results.description: A window of 300 rows with nothing to do: Application.Run's own loop on the virtual clock for 5 s (all under build); reports the loop's passes per second

results.name: loop/minimized window changed, 5 s, real loop
results.description: A minimized window of 300 rows that gains a row while minimized, as Junction's watcher refreshes a list: Application.Run's own loop on the virtual clock for 5 s (all under build); reports the loop's passes per second

results.name: loop/toast held 2 s, real loop
results.description: A toast over 300 rows, faded in, held 2 s and faded out: Application.Run's own loop on the virtual clock from the flash until it has gone (all under build); reports the loop's passes per second of its life

results.name: loop/tooltip delay, real loop
results.description: The pointer comes to rest on a button with a tooltip beside 300 rows: Application.Run's own loop on the virtual clock until the tooltip is shown (all under build); reports the loop's passes per second of the show delay

results.name: loop/toast over a screen built anew, real loop
results.description: A toast over a screen whose Build makes its ~300 elements again, as an app's does (Junction, Aperture and Meridian hand ToastHost their MarkDirty): Application.Run's own loop on the virtual clock from the flash until it has gone, held 1.7 s (all under build); reports the screen's builds per toast

results.name: loop/spinner on a screen built anew, rebuilt per step, real loop
results.description: A screen whose Build makes its ~300 elements again, with a turning spinner whose looping tween writes a phase field and calls the screen's MarkDirty, as Junction's busy buttons and toolbar fetch did: Application.Run's own loop on the virtual clock for 30 frames (all under build); reports the screen's builds per frame drawn

results.name: loop/spinner on a screen built anew, turned in place, real loop
results.description: The same screen with a turning spinner whose looping tween writes the live spinner's Transform through a Ref, as Junction's busy buttons now do: Application.Run's own loop on the virtual clock for 30 frames (all under build); reports the screen's builds per frame drawn

results.name: terminal/coloured screen, forced frame
results.description: A terminal in the platform's monospace face showing four `ls --color`-like listings, a colour change every few cells on every row, drawn again whole (a forced frame)

results.name: terminal/dense colour screen, unique rows, forced frame
results.description: A 1600×1000 terminal showing an htop- or diff-like screen, a colour change every two to four cells and every row different (numbered), drawn again whole (a forced frame): more colour stretches than the 2,048 blobs a context kept
